text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Hafez al-Assad accepts invitation from Armenian President Levon Ter-Petrosyan to visit Armenia.
- Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu clearly announced a war against peace and is pushing the situation towards the worst possibilities.
- After an Arab demand, the U.N. General Assembly starts discussions of a draft decision to stop the Israeli plans to build Jewish settlements in Arab East Jerusalem.
- France renews its firm position in the Middle East peace process, supporting the land-for-peace formula and the 1991 Madrid principles.
- The Higher Tourism Council discusses some projects and their possible economic gains and approves a plan for a shopping month in Damascus and Aleppo.
- Strong tension prevails in south Lebanon.
- Warnings of a destructive quake in Israel.
- Jews hold several key posts in the administration of U.S. President Bill Clinton.
